headline: Hi, I’m Rehan, designing digital products with clarity and purpose.
intro:
I’m a product-focused designer with a strong interest in creating intuitive, user-centered digital experiences. I enjoy working at the intersection of design, usability, and problem-solving, turning complex ideas into clear, meaningful interfaces.

My approach is rooted in understanding users, defining problems clearly, and designing with intention. From websites and mobile apps to SaaS products and dashboards, I focus on structure, consistency, and real-world usability rather than visual noise.
portrait_alt: Moinul Islam Rehan in a white TulipTech polo, arms crossed

experience.text: Designing product-based digital experiences at TulipTech. I work with cross-functional teams to understand user and business needs and turn them into interfaces that are intuitive, scalable and consistent to build.

Led UX on 30+ client projects across fintech, edtech, B2B SaaS, hiring platforms and film production, working directly with developers and project managers. Built and maintained a shared component library that unified the design language across client products and made developer handoff smoother.
Designed user flows, interfaces and design system components for client and internal products across web and SaaS platforms. Promoted from intern to UI/UX Engineer after three months.
Supported the design team on client and internal products across user research, interface design and design system work.

education.title: B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering (major in AI)
education.school: Bangladesh University of Business and Technology (BUBT)
education.text: Served as Vice Chairperson of the IEEE BUBT Student Branch, organizing technical workshops and events that strengthened leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills through active collaboration and club activities.

education.title: UI-UX Guided Program
education.text: Completed the UI-UX Guided Program at Ostad, gaining practical knowledge of user research, wireframing, design systems, prototyping, and usability principles. Worked on hands-on projects to strengthen problem-solving skills and apply user-centered design thinking to real-world scenarios.

milestones.text: Co-authored “AGRO AI”, peer-reviewed research published by Elsevier (Applied Food Research), from a NASA Space Apps Challenge 2024 project.
Vice Chairperson, IEEE BUBT Student Branch.
1st Runner-Up, Fall 2024 Brainstorming Competition, Dept. of CSE, BUBT.

contact_heading: I’m always open to new ideas, collaborations, or a simple conversation.
